_note: V3.5f, and the third event file. crises.json carries the preconditioned half and scandals.json the pure-hazard half; this file carries BOTH halves, on a PLACE -- rain is not deserved (the flood, no gate, the scandals' argument) and a heat wave is earned twice over (the gate, on the emissions field the V3.5 block shipped). The occasion is still V1.8's: every effect rides the shared channels, spending_pct_gdp and bloc_offset here, and no new channel exists. Both cards name no office -- a flood and a summer are about nobody, which is the honest value and also the shape the loader's gate check does not see (see src/core/data_loader.gd's V3.5f note before adding a third subjectless pure-hazard event).
_site_note: "sited": true is the whole content-side contract. Where the crisis lands is drawn at announcement, uniform over the nation's own regions, pure in (nation, event, absolute month) -- src/sim/events.gd owns all of it and the card, the calendar and the ledger read the place off the register. Content opts in and carries no mechanism, and nothing here is population-weighted: a weighted draw is Ile-de-France for ever (V2.6b1's static-site finding), and a disaster that cannot move is a decoration.
_gate_note: THE THRESHOLD WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS AUTHORED, on the baselines the V3.5 block committed, and 6.5 t opens the gate for SEVEN of twenty-nine: LUX 10.56, EST 7.76, BEL 7.31, CZE 7.13, DEU 6.94, POL 7.55, NLD 6.60 -- nearest below, AUT 6.32 and SVN 6.27; never for SWE 3.57, MLT 3.18 or the player's France at 4.0. The plan-time description said roughly the dirtier half; the roster says the dirtier quarter, and the count is recorded rather than the threshold tuned to the sentence. The field is LIVE -- V3.5c ticks it with the mix -- so the gate follows the grid a government actually builds, and that is the event's point: the heat wave is a consequence of the emissions, and France's opens only if its own electricity is rebuilt dirty.

events.name: The river breaks its banks
events.summary: Three days of rain and the valley is a lake. Two towns are cut off, the rail line is under water, and the prefect's damage list runs to forty communes. The works are not in question; whose answer it is, is.

choices.label: Repair by decree
choices.summary: The levees go back where the engineers draw the line, not where the communes asked, and the contracts are signed before the water has finished going down. The payroll is real; so is the memory of not being asked.

choices.label: Appeal for EU solidarity
choices.summary: The Union's solidarity fund answers in nine months, if it answers. The appeal photographs well in the capital; in the valley it reads as a government waiting for Brussels while the cellars are still wet.

choices.label: Let the water go down first
choices.summary: The assessment comes first, the cameras leave, and by the time the plan is ready the money's best use has gone with the water. The valley keeps the mud and the memory.

events.name: The heat does not break
events.summary: The fourteenth day over forty, the mortality figures moving, and the hospitals deferring surgery to hold the evening peak. Nobody in the country needs telling where summers like this one come from.

choices.label: Declare a health emergency
choices.summary: The wards reopen, the street-by-street visits to the elderly start tomorrow, and the deferrals stop. The health line carries the bill for the rest of the term, and business carries the midday stop.

choices.label: Cool the cities
choices.summary: Cooling rooms in every district, mist over the squares, the buses free between noon and four. The cities call it leadership; the countryside notes where the shade went up.

choices.label: Call it weather
choices.summary: It breaks in the end; summers always have. The excess deaths will be a line in a winter report, and the people they name will not be reading it.
